lines.t: (Intro)
Yeah…
I’ve been runnin’ from the truth too long—
Now I’m done. Let’s go.
(Verse 1)
Woke up with my heart still heavy,
Past on my back like a load I carry.
Used to blame God when my soul felt empty,
Now I talk to Him daily, He defends me.
Life hit hard—yeah, it cut like glass,
Tryna find peace in a whiskey glass.
Now I’m seein’ clear, no smoke, no mask,
Every scar I got got a purpose at last.
Used to curse in the mirror,
Now I’m speakin’ Scripture clearer.
Grace don’t come cheap—nah,
But the blood paid the price, now the way’s nearer.
You broke the chain, I’m free again,
Every wound You turned to strength within.
When I fall, You call my name,
Yeah, I rise through the pain—You broke the chain.
(Verse 2)
Yeah, I was angry, lost, and cold,
Heart made of stone, no hand to hold.
Had a voice in my head sayin’, “You’ll never change,”
But Your love rearranged everything I became.
Now I stand on the Word like a solid foundation,
No more fear, no hesitation.
Enemies lurk, temptation loud,
But I walk through the storm with a faith so proud.
This ain’t religion, it’s redemption’s song,
A prodigal kid who’s been gone too long.
You took the hate and turned it to flame,
Now every verse I spit just praises Your name.
(Bridge)
Every time I stumble, You lift me higher,
Turnin’ my guilt into holy fire.
No more chains, no more pain,
Just freedom in the blood that breaks every chain.
(Final Chorus)
You broke the chain, I’m free again,
Every wound You turned to strength within.
When I fall, You call my name,
Yeah, I rise through the pain—You broke the chain.
Hands to the sky, I’m not the same,
No fear remains—You broke the chain.
